correctness.rationale: For an arbitrary labeling, the unselected chord endpoints give a forbidden matching. Proved 6-point two-parity avoidance, inducting by fixing a nonforbidden chord; four-point Pfaffian switch computes the n-1 support boundary. Unique isolated missing-chord enumeration yields L_n; signed Pfaffian sum one gives n^2. Universal steps are algebraic, not numerical extrapolation. Standalone exact checker passed 18,556 direct support/parity cases and 76 six-vertex forbidden subsets.

value.rationale: The parity split is a natural canonical refinement of all perfect matchings. Complete all-size Boolean shattering classification is structurally richer than the known scalar VC bound: every lower face count is sign-independent, while highest-degree face counts have a sharp quadratic n^2 disparity from isolated chords. It gives an exact infinite-family invariant with plausible use in sign-constrained incidence learning and crossing-Pfaffian constructions.
